hook: Barret Zoph began his research career at the University of Southern California's Information Sciences Institute working on machine translation before joining Google Brain as a staff research scientist. There he co-authored Neural Architecture Search with Reinforcement Learning, one of the founding papers of the field that automated the design of neural network architectures, and later worked on sparse and mixture-of-experts techniques for scaling language models efficiently. He moved to OpenAI, rising to Vice President of Research for Post-Training, where his team worked on alignment, tool use, evaluations, and the multimodal capabilities behind ChatGPT and the OpenAI API. In 2025 he left to co-found Thinking Machines Lab alongside Mira Murati, becoming the company's Chief Technology Officer and helping build an AI research and product company focused on making AI systems more customizable and generally capable.
